stories.headline: Phantom Blade Zero launches on PC with a day-one performance patch
stories.summary: S-GAME's martial-arts action RPG launched worldwide on PC and PS5 on October 29 UTC. The studio says a roughly 5 GB day-one patch improves ray tracing and path tracing, and warns of instability with Nvidia driver 621.01, recommending 617.42 while a fix is pending.

stories.headline: Crimson Desert's Charting the Unknown expansion is out
stories.summary: Pearl Abyss launched the paid Charting the Unknown expansion on October 29 at 22:00 UTC. It adds seafaring and underwater exploration, expanded housing and business systems, and new character stories; the DLC requires Crimson Desert Enhanced.

stories.headline: Age of Empires IV adds Vikings and Scots in Raiders of the North
stories.summary: The Raiders of the North expansion launched October 29, introducing two playable civilizations, four new Crucible missions and two new biomes. The Crucible mode also gains two-player co-op, providing new ways for strategy fans to play together.

stories.headline: Cairn releases free Deep Water DLC and Free Roam mode
stories.summary: The Game Bakers released On the Trail: Deep Water on October 29 at no extra cost to Cairn owners. Three climbing areas introduce overwater routes, Marco becomes playable, and a free update lets players explore Mount Kami more freely.

stories.headline: Planet Coaster 2 launches Spooktacular Pack and free Update 12
stories.summary: Frontier's Halloween expansion arrived October 29 with custom walkthrough attractions, seven rides and more than 700 scenery pieces. The accompanying free Update 12 adds reaction points, photo stand-ins and a scared guest reaction for more expressive park design.

stories.headline: Stardeus v0.15 overhauls combat, quests and colony management
stories.summary: The October 29 update delivers more than 1,500 changes, including quests, faction diplomacy, a Rogue AI progression path, redesigned ship and ground combat, and a rebuilt interface. Saves from v0.14 are incompatible, but the developer provides a legacy branch for finishing older runs.

stories.headline: Sorry We're Closed is free to keep on the Epic Games Store
stories.summary: Epic is offering the base edition of the surreal survival-horror adventure for free from October 29 until November 5 at 16:00 UTC. Claiming it during the promotion adds a permanent Epic library license; the offer is separate from the paid Steam version.
